notes: Giving the supplied *the* of *the head* to εἰς rather than leaving the preposition unrepresented is the competing reading; rule 36's absorbed-into-a-predicate clause was followed.
οὐδέ takes the discontinuous *not … even* headed on the negation-bearing word; οἱ οἰκοδομοῦντες splits *the* / *builders* under rule 90's two-word case.
